• Find the genus, species, and strain designation of the
bacteria available in the product.
• Look for the numbers of each probiotic strain at the
end of the shelf-life.
• Find suggested serving size that will deliver the ef-
fective dose of probiotics.
• Find the proper storage conditions for the product.
